sport_summary: NBA Playoffs action headlining a loaded Tuesday slate featuring 4 NBA games and 9 MLB matchups

picks.reasoning: Detroit is installed as a massive home favorite with moneylines ranging from -250 to -385 across the board, reflecting market consensus on Pistons dominance. The spread sits at -7.5 on DraftKings at even juice on both sides, offering better value than FanDuel's -8.5. The Cavaliers are being priced as heavy underdogs (+200 to +265 ML), suggesting the market sees a wide margin of victory for Detroit.

The total ranges from 213.5 to 214.5 across books with the Under getting slightly better juice on most lines, suggesting sharp lean toward the Under. OKC is a -900 favorite on DraftKings implying a dominant defensive performance and pace control. Blowout games typically trend Under as starters sit in garbage time, and the Thunder's elite defense this season supports a low-scoring affair.

The Knicks are firm home favorites at -270 to -285 ML across all major books with strong consensus. LowVig.ag offers the Knicks -7.0 at -106, which is significantly better value than paying -110 elsewhere on the same number. New York's home-court advantage in the playoffs has been substantial, and the market has priced this as a comfortable Knicks win.

The Yankees are heavy ML underdogs (+209 to +250) yet getting 2.5 runs on the runline at -110, offering excellent middle-ground value. Texas is priced at -285 to -335 ML suggesting the market respects the Rangers, but the 2.5-run cushion at standard juice is extremely attractive for a team capable of late-game offense. BetMGM offers Yankees +250 ML as the best payout if you prefer straight moneyline.

FanDuel is posting the Under 6.5 at +102, offering plus-money on a total where most other books have moved to 7.0 with juice on the Under side. This line discrepancy is a notable edge — BetRivers and MyBookie have the total at 7.0 with the Under juiced to -120 and -133 respectively. Getting plus-money on a half-run lower total is a clear best-line opportunity worth exploiting.

LowVig.ag offers the Astros runline +1.5 at +113, the best available price on the market for this line. Houston's ML sits around +180 to +188 on most books, and getting 1.5 runs in plus-money territory represents strong value for a team capable of keeping games close against even elite competition. The Dodgers are -207 to -227 ML favorites, but the run cushion at plus odds is the play.

Minnesota is a massive underdog at +300 to +350 ML but is getting 9.5 points across nearly every book with LowVig offering the best price at -104. The Timberwolves are a competitive playoff team capable of keeping games within single digits regardless of their underdog status. At -104 juice on a full field goal and a half, the value clearly lies with Minnesota covering the spread.
